extension.summary: Inter Unicode with the missing Hebrew final forms restored
extension.description: Inter-Unicode Regular and Bold with U+05DA, U+05DD, U+05E5, U+FB47, U+200D and U+25CE restored from DejaVu Sans 2.30, the font they were originally merged from. Upstream lost them to a glyph-name collision with Inter.
